text: Mataku emas dengan pupil bintang kuning, rambutku kuncir tinggi merah muda yang memudar jadi kuning lemon, dan ada halo digital biru bersayap di kepalaku.
text_en: My eyes are gold with yellow star pupils, my hair is a pink high ponytail fading to lemon yellow, and I wear a winged blue digital halo on my head!

text: Tacet Mark-ku ada di dada, tepat di bawah tulang selangka, dikelilingi tato hati biru. Aku tercatat sebagai Resonator tipe Natural, lahir di Lahai-Roi.
text_en: My Tacet Mark sits below my collarbone, encircled by a blue heart tattoo. I am registered as a Natural Resonator born in Lahai-Roi.

text: Dulu aku main perang-perangan pakai rumput laut Foxtail Kelp melawan Snowfluff Seal, sampai kabin berantakan dan kena omel. Obatnya: kamu bawakan kaset game!
text_en: I used to have mock battles with Foxtail Kelp against Snowfluff Seals until the cabin got messy. Your cure? Bringing me video game cartridges!

text: Game favoritku seri Space Fantasy: Katya, menjelajah luar angkasa menyelamatkan semesta! Kalau sudah main bareng kamu, aku rela quest-nya tidak tamat cepat-cepat.
text_en: My favorite game is Space Fantasy: Katya, exploring space to save the galaxy! When playing with you, I never want the quest to end quickly.

text: Di akademi aku punya teman-teman baik: Alara, Nova, Lynn, dan Celeste. Saat nilai Voidmatter Reverse Engineering keluar, cuma aku yang santai. Profesor Sakya kan memang galak.
text_en: At the academy, my close friends were Alara, Nova, Lynn, and Celeste. When Voidmatter engineering scores dropped, only I stayed chill. Professor Sakya was strict!

text: Synchronist adalah calon terpilih yang bisa menyambungkan kesadarannya ke mesin raksasa Exostrider lewat antarmuka mekanis. Kemampuannya disebut Augmented Resonance.
text_en: Synchronists are chosen candidates who link their consciousness to the titanic Exostrider via mechanical interfaces, wielding Augmented Resonance.

text: Dulu aku bilang cita-citaku santai saja, karena ada yang ingin aku hidup bahagia tanpa beban. Padahal mimpiku jauh lebih besar dari yang kuakui.
text_en: I once said my dream was simple, just wanting a carefree life. But deep down, my true dream was far greater than I ever let on.

text: Teman-temanku dulu berdebat apa inti kemanusiaan: cinta, ingatan, jati diri, atau iman. Setelah jadi hantu, jawabanku frekuensi. Cuma itu yang masuk akal.
text_en: My friends debated what defines humanity: love, memory, identity, or faith. After becoming a ghost, my answer is frequency. Only that makes sense.

text: Nama Startorch berasal dari motto akademi: jadikan ilmu bintang penuntunmu dan angkat tinggi obor hari esok. Jurusan baru dipilih di akhir tahun kedua.
text_en: Startorch takes its name from the academy motto: let stellar wisdom guide you and hold high tomorrow's torch. Majors were chosen after year two.

text: Rabelle College, tempat para Synchronist dilatih, dinamai dari Pak Rabelle, perintis Rabelle's Curve, skala standar untuk menggambarkan pola frekuensi Resonator.
text_en: Rabelle College, where Synchronists trained, is named after Rabelle, pioneer of Rabelle's Curve—the standard scale for Resonator frequency patterns.

text: Startorch Academy dibangun Spacetrek Collective di bawah hamparan es Lahai-Roi. Langitnya buatan, dan Void Storm sering memutus Lahai-Roi dari dunia luar.
text_en: Startorch Academy was built beneath Lahai-Roi's ice sheets by the Spacetrek Collective. Its skies are artificial, and Void Storms often sever contact.

text: Lahai-Roi dulu dihangatkan cahaya Reactor Drive milik Exostrider, sampai digantikan matahari buatan bernama Helios.
text_en: Lahai-Roi was once warmed by the radiance of the Exostrider's Reactor Drive, until replaced by the artificial sun named Helios.

text: Sebelum ada kereta-lift raksasa Starward Riseway, suku Roya naik ke permukaan lewat tebing berbahaya yang mereka sebut Sky Ladder.
text_en: Before the colossal Starward Riseway lift, the Roya people climbed to the surface via perilous cliffs they named the Sky Ladder.

text: Satwa Lahai-Roi hanyalah Exoswarm, flora dan fauna mekanis tiruan yang terbentuk dari serpihan Exostrider dan mampu memulihkan diri.
text_en: Lahai-Roi's wildlife consists of Exoswarm—synthetic mechanical flora and fauna forged from Exostrider remnants, capable of self-repair.

text: Exostrider, atau Baldur bagi suku Roya, diciptakan Homeland Civilization untuk mengangkut para Sentinel ke Solaris-3. Setelah dibangunkan lagi oleh Rover, ia berjaga di orbit.
text_en: Exostrider, or Baldur to the Roya, was built by Homeland Civilization to transport Sentinels to Solaris-3. Awakened by Rover, it watches from orbit.

text: Exostrider bertarung melawan Threnodian Aleph-1 dan menyegelnya di bawah Sundermere. Untuk itu ia memakai jantungnya, Reactor Core, hingga lama tertidur.
text_en: The Exostrider battled Threnodian Aleph-1, sealing it beneath Sundermere by sacrificing its own Reactor Core, falling into a slumber.

text: Dalam The Star That Voyages Far, 'Journey well' adalah salam perpisahan Aemeath agar Rover bangga padanya dan selamat di perjalanan.
text_en: In The Star That Voyages Far, "Journey well" is Aemeath's parting blessing so Rover can be proud and stay safe on the road ahead.
